style.medium: Warm soft hand-painted gouache, smooth non-pixel illustration, restrained warm brown outlines
style.view: 2:1 isometric ground, elevated three-quarter props; avatar portrait remains circular and screen-facing
style.light: Soft upper-left daylight; warm fire accent, no baked floor or cast shadows on isolated sprites
style.character: Cream blank circular head, terracotta pear-shaped body, cream mittens and dark brown boots; no text or drawn face

camper-idle.action: standing relaxed with both feet planted, facing the viewer

camper-sit.action: seated on an invisible horizontal log, thighs forward and boots below knees, arms resting beside belly; clear bottom contact under pelvis

bench-ne.action: one low two-person log bench; long seating axis rises from lower left to upper right at 26.565 degrees; both top and front wood faces visible; no backrest

bench-nw.action: one low two-person log bench; long seating axis descends from upper left to lower right at 26.565 degrees; both top and front wood faces visible; no backrest

grass.action: flat seamless top-down soft green grass material, sparse fine blades, uniform scale and lighting; no objects, perspective, border or vignette
